find:
{
path?: string, // default: ".",
name?: string, // default: "None"
}

So call find({"path": ".", "name":"config.py"}).

Then parse output to get full path(s) found. Then read each file via cat to see last line. But they want after finding, display last line. Could just pick first occurrence.

Let's do find.
